crossRefs.note: This is what the Lord Yahweh says: “It shall not stand, neither shall it happen.”
For the head of Syria is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin. Within sixty-five years Ephraim shall be broken…
For before the child knows how to say, ‘My father,’ and, ‘My mother,’ the riches of Damascus and the plunder of Samaria…
Yahweh’s word that came to Micah the Morashtite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw…
But my words and my decrees, which I commanded my servants the prophets, didn’t they overtake your fathers? “Then they…
Then again I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, a flying scroll.
Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: The Lord sent a word into Jacob, and it falls on Israel.
translations.bsb: The Lord has sent a message against Jacob, and it has fallen upon Israel.
translations.kjv: The Lord sent a word into Jacob, and it hath lighted upon Israel.
translations.asv: The Lord sent a word into Jacob, and it hath lighted upon Israel.
